scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "faculty,admin,server,caddy" -c "blue,magenta,green,cyan" "pnpm run dev:faculty" "pnpm run dev:admin" "pnpm run server:dev" "pnpm run dev:proxy"
scripts.server:dev: cd apps && uv run --project server uvicorn server.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.server:test: cd apps && uv run --project server pytest
scripts.server:lint: cd apps && uv run --project server ruff check
scripts.server:format: cd apps && uv run --project server ruff format --check
scripts.server:migrate: cd apps/server && uv run alembic upgrade head
